verdicts.reason: A has a good top row (logo beside a one-line headline) and keeps the jar and CTA prominent, but the four-step list falls apart: step 1 is huge while steps 2–4 are tiny and scattered (step 2 floats mid-canvas, steps 3–4 sit ragged at the left), so the list loses its sequence and grouping. B is worse: the logo is oversized and competes with the headline, steps 2–4 are pinned to the left edge at an unreadable size, step 1 sits below them at the bottom so the order is broken, and the CTA is shrunk to a minor element.
